title: Speech Recognition Training Platform
description: End-to-end Whisper fine-tuning platform. Preprocessing with VAD (pyannote / Silero / Kaldi), Demucs separation, segment-level deduplication and augmentation; distributed training on DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 across four GPUs; Prefect orchestration with MLflow tracking and GCS autoresume. Containerized for GCP/Vertex AI and AWS. Currently running against a 200+ hour Marathi corpus.

title: AutoDub / VOIT — AI Dubbing Platform
description: Speech-to-speech dubbing across global and Indic languages. STT, regional TTS, voice cloning, accent conversion, and a dual-provider voice library with emotion variants. Automated QC grades accent and TTS quality using an audio model rather than manual listening. Delivered the first working Iberian Spanish, Delhi-accent Hindi and UAE Arabic clones.

title: Cloud Migration & Storage Infrastructure
description: Multi-worker Google Drive to S3/Wasabi transfer and metadata-extraction services. Threaded parallel transfer, S3 access points, purpose-built IAM roles and bucket policies. Ran the production migration end to end — and concluded from the evaluation that Wasabi wasn't needed, removing a redundant storage tier.

title: Dub-Storage — Enterprise Media Platform
description: Role-based media file platform: folder hierarchies, cut-paste, restore, upload/download tracking, activity reporting, rate limiting. Fixed database connection-pool exhaustion under load and enabled large-file uploads.
